headline: US Consumer Confidence Reaches Highest Level Since January 2025
summary: The US consumer confidence index rose 11.4 points to 103.3 in November, driven by increased optimism regarding job prospects and general business conditions.
why: Consumer confidence is a leading indicator of household spending, which accounts for a significant portion of US GDP.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Higher consumer confidence typically supports corporate earnings expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The significant jump in confidence data suggests a stronger-than-expected economic outlook, boosting investor sentiment.
